response.justification: Despite extensive experience as a senior software engineer, the candidate lacks Java-specific project experience relevant to the role, has only basic German language skills (a hard requirement), and is overqualified for an entry-level position, raising concerns about retention and role alignment.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical workshops
Proven expertise in agile practices, CI/CD, and cloud technologies
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, failing to meet required fluency
No demonstrable Java project experience despite listing it as a skill
Overqualified with 10+ years of senior roles, mismatched for entry-level position
